title: Author purpose Practice 1
description: 4 short texts - 8 focused author purpose questions
subject: rla
passage:
TEXT A - Composting Flyer

A flyer explains where apartment residents can drop off food scraps, what materials are accepted, and when collection bins are emptied.

TEXT B - Shade Editorial

An editorial urges the city to plant more street trees near bus stops and cites summer temperature readings from unshaded sidewalks.

TEXT C - Bee Tracking

A science article describes tiny numbered tags placed on bees and cameras that record which tagged insects return to a hive entrance.

TEXT D - Room Booking

A workplace message announces that meeting rooms must now be booked through a shared calendar and gives three steps for reserving a room.

questions.rule: Name the relationship first, then prove it with the surrounding text.
